01地缘政治与海事安全 · 2026年11月23日

CNN：霍尔木兹袭击达开战以来最高水平，10月逾30起、11月已22起

Iranian attacks in the Strait of Hormuz are at the highest levels since the conflict began

Reported attacks on shipping in and around the Strait of Hormuz are at the highest levels since the Iran war began, maritime data shows: in October, attacks reported to the Royal Navy-affiliated United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations Centre (UKMTO) exceeded 30 for the first time since the war began in late February, and as of Sunday at least 22 had been reported in November, the second-highest monthly figure, according to a CNN analysis of UKMTO data, against a pre-October average of around 10 a month. Projectiles struck three tankers exiting the strait on Friday and Saturday, according to maritime risk firm Marisks: fire erupted aboard the Captain Leon, a Marshall Islands-flagged chemical and oil tanker, after it was struck at the bow at 3 p.m. UTC on Friday; the Hong Kong-flagged crude tanker Torkel caught fire after being hit in the stern at 5 a.m. UTC on Saturday, and less than an hour later the also Hong Kong-flagged Arina was struck in the engine room by a missile. Marisks did not confirm who was behind the attacks, though it said Iranian involvement was "assessed as likely", while Kpler reported that Iranian oil on water outside the US blockade zone has hit zero and that Iran's oil revenues could drop to zero by mid-December.

CNN 对英国海上贸易行动中心（UKMTO）数据的分析显示，霍尔木兹海峡及周边报告的袭击处于美伊战争（2月底爆发）以来最高水平：10 月报告袭击逾 30 起，为开战以来首次；截至周日，11 月已有至少 22 起，为第二高月份，而开战前月均约 10 起。最新三起为周五至周六出海峡的油轮：马绍尔群岛籍化学品/油轮 Captain Leon 周五 15:00 UTC 船头中弹起火；香港籍原油轮 Torkel 周六 05:00 UTC 船尾中弹起火；不到一小时后同为香港籍的 Arina 机舱被导弹击中；海事风险公司 Marisks 称伊朗参与“评估为可能”，但未证实。Kpler 称封锁区外的伊朗海上原油已降至零，伊朗石油收入可能在 12 月中旬前归零。

02地缘政治与海事安全 · 2026年11月22日

疑似无人机袭击致俄船在利比亚班加西港爆炸

Suspected Drone Attack Caused Explosion On Russian Ship At Benghazi Port

Libya's eastern-based government said on Sunday that a preliminary investigation indicated an explosion at the Benghazi naval base occurred aboard a Russian ship docked at the city's port, with a drone attack suspected. The vessel had stopped at Benghazi to refuel and resupply on its way back to Russia under maritime cooperation agreements between the two countries; two medical sources said no deaths had been reported but there were injuries, with the number and nationalities of the injured not immediately known. There was no immediate reaction from Russian authorities and no one had claimed responsibility, while the government said port and naval base facilities were safe, normal operations would resume once the fire was under control, and it condemned the suspected attack as a violation of Libya's sovereignty and a threat to maritime safety, vowing legal and diplomatic measures against those found responsible.

利比亚东部政府周日表示，初步调查显示班加西海军基地发生爆炸，事发船只为一艘停靠在该市港口的俄罗斯船舶，疑似遭到无人机袭击。该船在返回俄罗斯途中停靠班加西加油补给，系根据两国海事合作协议安排；两名医疗消息人士称无死亡报告但有人受伤，伤者人数与国籍暂不明。俄罗斯方面暂无回应，也无人认领袭击；东部政府称港口与海军基地设施安全，灭火并确保现场安全后将恢复正常运营，并谴责此次疑似袭击侵犯利比亚主权、威胁海上安全，将采取法律与外交措施追究责任。

03地缘政治与海事安全 · 2026年11月22日

Sparta II 遭袭后仍在芬兰湾燃烧，16 名船员已撤离

Russian Cargo Ship Still On Fire Off Finland After Attack

A fire onboard the Russian cargo ship Sparta II continued to burn through the night even as efforts were made to douse the flames, Finland's coast guard said on Sunday. The Finnish military has said the strike on Saturday was likely carried out by Ukraine and that the vessel later drifted into Finnish waters where it remains at anchor, with the 16 crew members evacuated onto a nearby Russian ship. Coast guard pictures and video showed several vessels spraying the ship with water cannons during the night to put out the flames and cool containers stacked on deck. The 121-metre Russian-flagged vessel, owned by Oboronlogistika, which provides logistics services for the Russian Defence Ministry and is subject to US sanctions, left St Petersburg on Friday bound for Kaliningrad and was damaged in international waters west of Russia's Gogland island; Estonia's navy commander said on Sunday that the risk of further attacks in the Gulf of Finland cannot be ruled out.

芬兰海岸警卫队周日表示，遭无人机袭击的俄罗斯货船 Sparta II 舱内大火彻夜未灭，尽管多艘船只连夜用水炮灭火降温。芬兰军方称该船周六遇袭很可能为乌克兰所为，随后漂入芬兰水域锚泊，16 名船员已撤离至附近一艘俄罗斯船只。该船为 121 米俄罗斯籍货船，船东 Oboronlogistika（为俄国防部提供物流服务，受美国制裁），周五自圣彼得堡出发前往加里宁格勒，在戈格兰岛以西国际水域受损；爱沙尼亚海军司令周日表示，芬兰湾再次遇袭的风险不能排除。

04地缘政治与海事安全 · 2026年11月22日

巴林要求安理会采取行动并令伊朗全额赔偿

Bahrain demands UN action, compensation for Iranian attacks

Bahrain demanded early on Sunday that Iran be held accountable and pay full compensation for attacks on the kingdom, urging firm action by the UN Security Council. In a statement, the Foreign Ministry rejected Tehran's justification for the attacks, saying that an industrial facility recently hit was civilian, and accused Iran of using disputes with other countries as a pretext to attack Bahrain, endanger civilians and violate the Gulf state's sovereignty, adding that Bahrain reserves the right to defend itself, alone or with its allies, at a time and place of its choosing. The ministry called on the Security Council to implement Resolution 2817, adopted on 11 March, which condemns Iranian attacks on Gulf states and Jordan and demands an end to hostilities and maritime interference; the statement followed attacks on Saturday that set an industrial facility ablaze, causing property damage but no injuries, while the Bahrain Defence Force reported intercepting several attacks, with minor damage from falling debris.

巴林周日凌晨要求伊朗为袭击承担责任并支付全额赔偿，敦促联合国安理会采取坚决行动。外交部声明驳斥了伊朗为袭击所作的辩解，强调日前被击中的工业设施为民用设施而非军事目标，指责伊朗借与其他国家的争端为借口袭击巴林、危及平民并侵犯其主权，并保留单独或与盟友共同自卫的权利。声明呼吁安理会执行 2026年3月11日通过的第 2817 号决议（谴责伊朗对海湾国家与约旦的袭击并要求停止敌对与海上干扰）；此前周六的袭击致一处工业设施起火，造成财产损失但无人受伤，巴林国防军称拦截了数起袭击，碎片坠落造成轻微损失。

05能源、油气与油轮 · 2026年11月22日

伊朗拟派14艘油轮冲击美国封锁，4300万桶原油滞留

Iran Prepares 14 Oil Tankers to Challenge US Blockade in Arabian Gulf

Iran is preparing to send 14 oil tankers through the US naval blockade, Iranian lawmaker Vahid Ahmadi, a member of parliament's National Security Committee, said, with more than 14 tankers reportedly positioned near Kharg Island, Iran's main oil export terminal, with crews assigned and Iranian flags raised ahead of a possible attempt to break the blockade, although he did not identify the vessels, their destinations or when they might attempt to cross, and there has been no independent confirmation that the operation has begun. According to commodity intelligence firm Kpler, around 43 million barrels of Iranian oil remain stranded inside the blockade zone, while approximately 20 tankers have been identified near Kharg Island, most of them loaded but stationary, and Kpler analyst Homayoun Falakshahi has warned that payments from Iran's remaining oil shipments could dry up by mid-December, potentially depriving Tehran of $3 billion to $6 billion in monthly revenue. Deputy Foreign Minister Kazem Gharibabadi said on Saturday that Iran would take "any action necessary" to break the blockade, while a Qatari delegation held two hours of talks in Tehran on Friday; shipping through the strait was approximately 65 per cent below pre-war levels, with 263 vessel crossings in the week ending November 18, compared with 308 the previous week.

伊朗正准备派 14 艘油轮穿越美国海军封锁，伊朗议会国家安全委员会成员 Vahid Ahmadi 称，逾 14 艘油轮已部署在主要出口港哈尔克岛附近，船员已就位并升起伊朗国旗，军舰护航是考虑中的方案之一；但未指明船名、目的地与时间，也无独立证实行动已经开始。Kpler 称约 4300 万桶伊朗原油滞留于封锁区内，哈尔克岛附近约有 20 艘油轮，大多满载停泊；分析师警告剩余油款可能在 12 月中旬前断流，每月损失 30–60 亿美元收入。伊朗副外长周六称将采取“一切必要行动”打破封锁，同时卡塔尔代表团周五在德黑兰举行了两小时会谈；霍尔木兹通行量已较战前低约 65%，截至 11月18日一周通行 263 艘次，低于前一周的 308 艘次。

来源 Source: Gulf News · 发布 Published 2026年11月22日阅读原文 Read original →
06能源、油气与油轮 · 2026年11月22日

霍尔木兹通行量一周降15%，油轮过境由52艘减至37艘

Ship traffic through Strait of Hormuz drops by 15%

At least 25 tankers have been attacked in and around the Strait of Hormuz over the past week as Iran has intensified its military activities in the Persian Gulf, Al Jazeera reports, citing Iranian military statements that could not be independently verified. According to the United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations (UKMTO), 263 vessels passed through the Strait of Hormuz between November 12 and 18, a 15% decrease compared with the previous week, while the number of oil tankers passing through the strait fell from 52 to 37. Experts believe that by intensifying its attacks, Tehran is seeking to put pressure on the United States and its regional allies and force Washington to abandon its economic blockade, and Trita Parsi, executive vice president of the Quincy Institute, said that the continuation of the US naval blockade increases the risk of military escalation.

据半岛电视台报道，过去一周在霍尔木兹海峡及周边至少有 25 艘油轮遭袭（该数字引自伊朗军方说法，未经独立核实）。英国海上贸易行动中心（UKMTO）数据显示，11月12–18日通过霍尔木兹海峡的船舶为 263 艘次，较前一周下降 15%；同期油轮过境由 52 艘降至 37 艘。分析人士认为，伊朗正通过加大袭击向美国及其地区盟友施压，以迫使华盛顿放弃经济封锁；昆西研究所副总裁 Trita Parsi 称封锁持续将加大军事升级风险。

07港口与码头、物流与供应链 · 2026年11月23日

NMDC 拿下印度新港 Machilipatnam 1.12亿美元疏浚合同

NMDC seals $112m dredging deal for new Indian port

Abu Dhabi-based NMDC Dredging & Marine has landed an AED411.4m ($112m) contract for capital dredging at India's new Machilipatnam port in Andhra Pradesh. The marine contractor, part of ADX-listed NMDC Group, has signed the agreement with Indian infrastructure company Megha Engineering & Infrastructure Limited (MEIL), which is building the greenfield port on the country's east coast. NMDC Group confirmed that dredging works are scheduled to start in December 2026 and run through September 2027, covering the seabed dredging needed to establish navigable depths for the new facility, which is being developed under an engineering, procurement and construction arrangement with MEIL holding the main construction contract.

阿布扎比 NMDC Dredging & Marine 拿下印度安得拉邦新建 Machilipatnam 港的资本疏浚合同，金额 4.114 亿迪拉姆（约1.12亿美元）。该公司为阿布扎比证券交易所上市公司 NMDC Group 旗下海事承包商，已与承建该绿地港口的印度基建公司 Megha Engineering & Infrastructure Limited（MEIL）签约，疏浚作业定于2026年12月启动、2027年9月完成，内容为疏浚海床以形成新港通航水深。Machilipatnam 是安得拉邦重点绿地港口项目之一，按工程总承包（EPC）模式开发，MEIL 持有主建设合同，NMDC 此次承接其中的资本疏浚包。

来源 Source: Splash247 / Splash Ports · 发布 Published 2026年11月23日阅读原文 Read original →
08港口与码头、物流与供应链 · 2026年11月22日

阿曼港口助海湾邻国维持贸易流通，杜库姆与苏哈尔承接转运

Oman's ports help Gulf neighbours keep trade moving, analyst says

Oman is using its geography and ports to help its Gulf neighbours keep goods moving amid disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz, said Yousuf Al Bulushi, chairman of the Muscat Policy Council, speaking in Naples. He pointed to the UAE–Oman Green Corridors, which fast-track cargo across the border by land and connect it to shipping routes, and cited Saudi-bound cargo moving through Oman's ports of Duqm and Sohar.

阿曼正利用其地理位置与港口帮助海湾邻国在霍尔木兹海峡受扰之际维持货物贸易流通，马斯喀特政策委员会主席 Yousuf Al Bulushi 在那不勒斯表示。阿联酋—阿曼“绿色通道”通过陆路快速通关把货物运过边境并接驳海运；运往沙特的货物正经由阿曼的杜库姆港与苏哈尔港转运。
